source_name: ДЗС — North Macedonia in Figures / MAKStat Selection annual compendia
why_relevant: Bilingual annual compendium giving fast cross-domain baselines (population, households, trade, ICT) useful for sizing and for English-language citation in deliverables.

source_name: Централен регистар на РСМ (Central Registry) — institutional portal
why_relevant: Custodian of the Trade Register and Register of Other Legal Entities, the Register of Beneficial Owners and the Register of Annual Accounts. It is the authoritative resolver of WHO exists in the MK payments market — banks, payment institutions, e-money issuers, fintechs, POS/ATM vendors — and their ownership and filings.

source_name: ЦРРСМ — Дистрибутивен систем (data distribution system)
why_relevant: The registry's paid bulk/structured data-delivery channel; the realistic route to a maintained list of licensed payment-market legal entities and their financials rather than one-off lookups.

source_name: ЦРРСМ — Основен профил на регистриран субјект (basic entity profile lookup)
why_relevant: Public-facing basic profile service (name, EMBS, activity code, status, managers) — the cheapest way to verify existence, NKD activity code and status of a specific payment institution or fintech.

source_name: ЦРРСМ — Регистар на вистински сопственици (Register of Beneficial Owners)
why_relevant: Beneficial-ownership data for MK legal entities; relevant for mapping who actually controls payment institutions, e-money issuers and fintech vendors, and for AML-adjacent due diligence in competitive intelligence.

source_name: ЦРРСМ — Регистар на годишни сметки (Register of Annual Accounts)
why_relevant: Ten-plus years of filed annual accounts for non-financial-sector entities; supports revenue/size tracking of merchants, POS/ATM vendors, IT integrators and non-bank payment players that never appear in central-bank statistics.

source_name: ЦРРСМ — Проверка и резервација на име на субјект (name search)
why_relevant: Free public name-search endpoint; a practical zero-cost way to confirm whether a payments/fintech brand exists as a registered MK entity and to discover exact legal names before paid lookups.

source_name: Министерство за финансии (Ministry of Finance) — Статистика section
why_relevant: Fiscal and treasury statistics (budget execution, public debt, revenue by tax type incl. VAT). VAT and fiscalised-turnover revenue series are a useful indirect read on formal retail consumption and therefore on card/cash payment volumes.

source_name: МФ — Месечен билтен (Ministry of Finance Monthly Bulletin)
why_relevant: Long-running monthly bulletin with consolidated macro-fiscal, real-sector and often monetary tables; a single recurring artefact that carries many of the denominators this workstream needs, with stable periodicity.

source_name: Open Finance portal (МФ) — open.finance.gov.mk
why_relevant: Transaction-level publication of budget-user payments. For payments intelligence this reveals public-sector spend on banking, card-processing, POS/ATM and IT services — i.e. who supplies the state and at what value.

source_name: МФ — Регистар на јавни субјекти (Register of Public Entities)
why_relevant: Authoritative list of public-sector entities; used to scope which bodies are in the Open Finance transaction universe and to resolve institution names appearing in payment/procurement records.

source_name: Управа за јавни приходи (УЈП / Public Revenue Office) — main portal
why_relevant: Tax administration and the regulator/operator of fiscalisation. Its guidance, rulebooks and news are the primary public record on the installed base of fiscal devices, GPRS/online connection of cash registers to UJP servers, and rules governing cash payment registration — directly relevant to POS estimation and cash-usage policy.

source_name: УЈП — Годишен извештај (annual reports series)
why_relevant: Annual reports (ISSN 1857-7121) carry counts of registered taxpayers, fiscalisation controls, numbers of fiscal devices and enforcement statistics — one of the few public series that quantifies the merchant/cash-register population underlying POS acceptance.

source_name: УЈП — Фискализација и регистрирање на готовинските плаќања (handbook)
why_relevant: Authoritative reference on who must fiscalise, device requirements and cash-payment registration rules — the legal/technical baseline for interpreting MK cash-usage and POS-terminal dynamics and for vendor market sizing.

source_name: data.gov.mk — national open data portal
why_relevant: Cross-institution dataset catalogue (SSO, MoF, UJP, CRM publishers). Best single place to discover machine-readable datasets in this cell that are not linked from the parent institution's own site.

source_name: uslugi.gov.mk — national e-services catalogue
why_relevant: Catalogue of state e-services per institution, incl. Central Registry entries; useful for enumerating exactly which registry/tax data services exist, their fees and their legal basis, and for spotting new digital-payment-enabled public services.

source_name: Slobodenpristap.mk — FOI request platform (institution pages for CRM, MF, UJP, SSO)
why_relevant: Public archive of freedom-of-information requests and responses to these very institutions — an access route to non-published aggregates (e.g. counts of registered payment-related entities, fiscal device counts) and evidence of what each body will or will not release.

source_name: CompanyWall MK — commercial aggregator of Central Registry filings
why_relevant: Re-publishes CRM registration and annual-account data in a searchable, sometimes free-tier form; a practical fallback when CRM's own paid channels are out of budget, and a cross-check on entity identifiers.

source_name: ДЗС eStat / statistical business register services
why_relevant: SSO's user-services entry point (incl. requests for tailored tabulations and business-register-based counts of active enterprises by NKD activity, e.g. financial services and retail) — the route to breakdowns not in the public tables.

source_name: Македонска банкарска асоцијација (МБА) — Macedonian Banking Association
why_relevant: Umbrella body founded by all banks and savings houses operating under the Law on Banks; its membership page resolves the full population of banks, savings houses plus KIBS (clearing house) and the Macedonian Credit Bureau — the exact actor set behind card/ATM/POS statistics. Also publishes statements and reports that carry quantitative claims and sector positions on fees, cash and payment-security rules.

source_name: МБА — Соопштенија (press statements / position announcements)
why_relevant: Where the banking industry states collective positions — e.g. the association's announcement that strong customer authentication for electronic payments applies from 1 March 2026 under the Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems. Such statements date rule changes that shift card/e-commerce transaction behaviour.

source_name: SKIBOR (МБА interbank reference rate portal) + Референтни банки list
why_relevant: Association-run benchmark portal; the 'референтни банки' panel is itself a curated pointer to the most significant banks, and the rate series is a recurring quantitative publication produced by the association rather than the central bank.

source_name: Стопанска комора на Северна Македонија (Economic Chamber of North Macedonia) — main portal
why_relevant: Oldest and largest national business chamber; organises members into здруженија (associations), групации (groups), асоцијации, регионални комори and совети. This taxonomy is the master pointer for reaching trade, ICT, financial, hospitality and fuel-retail member populations in one place, and its news feed carries positions on fiscalisation, fees and payment obligations.

source_name: Здружение на трговијата при Стопанска комора на СМ (Trade Association)
why_relevant: Unites wholesale and retail legal entities — i.e. the merchant/acceptance side of card payments. Explicitly mandated to propose legislative measures and advocate regulatory change, which is where merchant complaints about card acceptance fees, cash-limit rules and fiscalisation surface. Chairman and secretary contacts are published, enabling actor mapping.

source_name: Здружение на финансиски организации при Стопанска комора на СМ
why_relevant: Described as the only organisational form uniting all financial-sector actors — banks, insurers, pension fund managers, non-bank financial companies, leasing companies and savings houses. Broader membership than the banking association alone, so it resolves the non-bank payments/credit periphery relevant to card and cash behaviour.

source_name: Групација на небанкарски финансиски друштва при Стопанска комора на СМ
why_relevant: Formed 9 October 2019 inside the Financial Organisations Association with declared goals and priorities for developing the 'fintech' industry — a documented lobbying track for payment/fintech regulation and a roster of non-bank credit and fintech firms.

source_name: Асоцијација на финансиски друштва на Северна Македонија (AFD)
why_relevant: Membership body for financial-technology and other non-bank financial companies serving residents of North Macedonia; publishes member-accession news (e.g. Кредит Јес joining in 2021). Resolves the non-bank lender/fintech population that competes with card credit and cash.

source_name: МАСИТ — Стопанска комора за информатички и комуникациски технологии (ICT Chamber)
why_relevant: Self-described voice of the Macedonian ICT industry, transformed from association to chamber in April 2007; covers software/IT services, hardware and distributors, telecoms and consultancies. Its members list resolves the vendor population supplying POS/ATM, card processing and payment software, and it co-sponsors e-commerce/payment initiatives.
